prompt:
CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is human-scale to slightly larger (8-15 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a SWARMER unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Wretch, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Minor.
Creature Category: Hollow Creature.
Combat Role: SWARMER.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW WRETCH — The most basic Hollow unit. A small Gate-born husk formed from erased memory.

BODY: Thin, emaciated charcoal-black humanoid. NOT flesh, NOT bone, NOT metal — pure void-stuff given勉强 humanoid shape. The body looks like a silhouette that someone started to draw and then abandoned — incomplete, edges fading into nothing. The form is hollow — not skeletal, but literally empty. A negative-space wound runs through the torso, showing ACTIVE NOTHING inside — not darkness, not shadow, but the visual absence of reality. Looking into the wound should feel like looking at a place that does not exist.

MASK: An incomplete mask covers where a face should be. The mask is white-grey, cracked, only half-formed — like a porcelain face that was never finished. One side has a suggestion of an eye socket; the other side is just smooth absence. No mouth. The mask is not worn — it IS the face, or the lack of one.

CRACKS: White fracture cracks run through the charcoal body like broken glass — NOT glowing, NOT warm, but cold white lines where light goes to die. The cracks pulse faintly with anti-light (light being absorbed, not emitted).

GATE STONE: A single small fragment of broken Gate stone (dark grey-brown arch stone) is embedded in the chest area — not as armor, not as decoration, but as a scar. This is the piece of the Mythos Gate that created this Wretch. The stone glows faintly with cold white anti-light.

ARMS: Long, thin arms ending in jagged charcoal fingers. No weapons — the fingers ARE the weapon, sharp void-edges that scratch and erase. Arms slightly too long for the body, reaching.

POSE: Lurching forward, reaching toward the viewer. Not aggressive — more like a drowning thing reaching for air. Several Wretches should be visible in the background at different distances, emerging from a Gate fracture in the ground — a jagged crack in reality leaking void-stuff.

SCALE: Human-scale but slightly taller (8-10 feet). Low camera angle. The Wretch looks down at the viewer with its half-mask. Tiny broken rubble at its feet for scale reference.

GROUND: The ground around the Wretch is WRONG — ash and debris falling UPWARD. Cracks of white anti-light spread from where it stands. The earth looks like it is being erased, not cracked — the ground itself is fading to nothing in patches.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment — not a dungeon, not a cave, but the space BETWEEN Realms. Faint Gate-arch silhouettes in the far distance, broken and crumbling. Cold white anti-light filtering through void-fog. No warm colors. Palette: charcoal-black, void-grey, cold white, faint anti-light blue-white.

VFX: Anti-light absorption — light bends toward the Wretch and does not escape. Cold white fracture cracks. Ash falling upward. Faint void-fog drifting around its feet.

SILHOUETTE: Thin, reaching, incomplete. Reads as a swarm unit — small, numerous, threatening in groups but not individually. The silhouette should look WRONG — like a humanoid shape that is being erased from the feet up.
